summary: The new #189 rl-capability-map-v1 campaign completed all nine frozen cases once, passed zero-physics independent verification with the exact sealed reference digest, and committed the per-case results document.
completed: Passed the exact-head owner precheck, clean non-development qualification, and zero-step preparation; preparation returned READY_AWAITING_START with physics_steps=0 and no campaign ledger.
Created user-authorized START_FORMAL_CAPTURE authorization bound to the frozen launch HEAD, protocol hash, prepared-manifest hash, and max_attempts=9.
Issued one formal capture invocation; all nine cases completed and their raw traces, analyses, claims, and permanent ledger were preserved.

Ran the offline verifier against the same prepared/capture bundles; final result VERIFIED, external ledger checked, nine attempts consumed, physics_steps=0, and the sealed reference digest independently recomputed.

Committed exactly docs/validation/rl_capability_map_successor_20260924/RESULTS.md in commit de21d8c3267e1c985cb57ed2d02004c686d05bd1, with parent e40b0933572345f23b37e3bb06350518fde63e76; left the worktree clean and detached for Praxis publication.

observations.text: The owner precheck passed all eight frozen gates on exact launch HEAD e40b0933572345f23b37e3bb06350518fde63e76; the protocol hash remained 0eda1a046d4d9c456a3ee5a281cc183eaf188b0ff9db9fe0767bc5f6011dc803.
All 35 targeted preflight integration and CurrentIdentity tests passed, including detached exact-binding success and wrong issue, wrong task path, and incomplete binding fail-closed cases.

The copied #178 sentinel bytes remained unchanged; the repaired analyzer JSON-serialized a native bool and retained PASS, sealed digest 1355515e5749d8aad8822c5e52dc20cdc824ad24f3360112e8d1066edf274484, mean vx 0.885882509707172 m/s, and progress 10.486111570522883 m.
Clean qualification was ENGINEERING_ADMITTED with all eight checks returning 0; zero-step preparation returned READY_AWAITING_START with physics_steps=0 and the permanent campaign ledger absent.

The single capture completed as CAPTURE_COMPLETE / CHARACTERIZED with nine consumed case records. flat_reference, step_5cm_cross, step_10cm_cross, repeated_steps_cross, and low_friction_cross were PASS; flat_half_speed, flat_reverse_probe, flat_lateral_probe, and flat_yaw_probe were PERFORMANCE_FAIL; no safety or integrity stop occurred.
The evidence-package ledger copy is byte-identical to the permanent task-local ledger and its campaign and per-case claims match the capture bundle.
The first unmodified baseline verify attempt stopped before row replay with ValueError: preflight identity mismatch; that failure bundle is preserved.
The completed offline verification returned VERIFIED, checked the external ledger, consumed 9 attempts, integrated zero physics steps, and independently recomputed the sealed flat_reference digest.
The committed RESULTS.md is the only file in the final commit; its parent is the frozen launch HEAD and the tracked worktree is clean and detached.

inferences.text: The initial verification failure is caused by the verifier comparing the correct empty actual branch of a detached worktree with the task logical branch. The transient adapter revalidated all five Praxis fields before mapping only that empty branch value in memory; the captured bundle and verifier source stayed unchanged.
The classifications characterize only the frozen checkpoint, adapter, reset, scenes, and command set; they do not establish hardware behavior or general robustness.

conclusions.text: Issue #189 is a completed prospective successor campaign, not a retry of #178: one invocation consumed the nine frozen cases and the permanent ledger was preserved.

Under the unchanged frozen protocol, the exact flat reference and four terrain cases pass; the half-speed, reverse, lateral, and yaw probes are performance failures. Independent offline verification confirms the case records and sealed reference digest.
The required per-case results are committed in a single tracked file at de21d8c3267e1c985cb57ed2d02004c686d05bd1; no push was performed.

uncertainty.text: Behavior outside the protocol’s specified model, reset, scenes, and commands remains unmeasured; no hardware or broader robustness claim follows from this campaign.

The unmodified baseline verifier’s detached-branch comparison remains a source-level limitation; this campaign’s successful verification used the disclosed process-local identity adapter after the standard invocation failed.
